fields.label: Period
fields.description: e.g. 'Year 1', 'Year 2', 'Year 3', 'Per-unit call tariff' — one row per year column (or per-unit tariff line) of the pack's official pricing grid

fields.label: Once-Off (R)
fields.description: Once-off cost for this period (e.g. Musina's Year 1 implementation/setup column)

fields.label: Monthly (R)
fields.description: Monthly cost for this period, as the official grid's Monthly column demands

fields.label: Annual Total (R)
fields.description: Annual total for this period — self-audit: once-off + 12 × monthly where the grid works that way; the full-term sum must reconcile to the cover price

fields.label: Unit Tariff (R)
fields.description: Per-unit call tariff lines: the rate per unit — the actual variable value is dependent on call activity over the term, so no fixed total exists for these rows

fields.label: Per Unit
fields.description: What one unit is for a tariff line, e.g. 'per logged call'

fields.label: Escalation Applied %
fields.description: Escalation applied to this period's prices over the prior period (e.g. 5.0 on a fixed-%-per-annum schedule — TWK's 5-year shape); leave blank on firm-price grids

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Pack-specific notes for this row, e.g. the grid's own wording for what the column covers
